name: Quivver → BTB — v5 (Looped Runway + Bass EQ)
description: v5: Addresses the structural rhythmic clash. Quivver's outro has 8th-note kicks (not clean 4/4), so BTB's straight 4/4 kick fights the rhythm. Fix: kill BTB's low end during early overlap (bass starts at 0.0, ramps to 1.0). BTB enters as mids/highs first (percussive texture), then bass ramps in as Quivver fades. This mimics a DJ using the bass EQ knob.

tracks.name: Below The Belt (Chris Micali Remix)
tracks.notes: LUFS -13.9. Back to original first_beat_sample (phase correction not needed — issue is structural rhythm, not timing). 4 loop copies keep vocal out of overlap.

transitions.notes: v5: Same volume automation as v3. Added 3-band EQ on incoming (BTB): bass killed at start (0.0), ramps to full (1.0) across the overlap. BTB enters as hi-hats/percussion texture only, then bass gradually fills in as Quivver's 8th-note kicks fade. Crossover at 250Hz catches the kick fundamental without touching upper harmonics.
